task_instance: Evaluate a new vendor proposal (CloudSync Storage Solutions, a cloud backup/DR platform) against Acme Corp's current on-prem backup setup, producing a full vendor review following the skill's output template: cost analysis (TCO), risk assessment, strengths/concerns, recommendation, and negotiation points.
evidence: Created a realistic sample vendor proposal at vendor_proposal.md (pricing, SLA, security/compliance, company background, and current-state comparison data for a 250-user cloud backup/DR vendor). Then produced the full deliverable at vendor_review_cloudsync.md following the skill's exact output template: Summary, Cost Analysis table (Year 1 $69k-$77k, 3-Year $183k-$207k, computed from the proposal's license/implementation/training/support figures and compared against the current on-prem baseline of ~$85k/year), Risk Assessment table (6 risks with likelihood/impact/mitigation derived from proposal details such as the 3-year lock-in, 50% early-termination fee, missing pen-test report, and lack of EU data residency), Strengths, Concerns, a Negotiate recommendation with reasoning, and 5 concrete negotiation points. Verified by reading the produced file back in full. This is a pure text-analysis-and-writing task (read a document, compute cost totals by hand, structure a markdown report) requiring no code execution, no binary file output, and no connector/tool access, so it was fully achievable within the office-assistant runtime's read/write/edit text-file abilities alone.
